methods.name: start
methods.comment: Starts the camera preview.

methods.name: stop
methods.comment: Stops the camera preview.

methods.name: capture
methods.comment:
Captures a picture from the camera.

If `storeToFile` was set to `true` when starting the preview, the returned
`value` will be an absolute file path on the device instead of a base64 string. Use getBase64FromFilePath to get the base64 string from the file path.

methods.name: captureSample
methods.comment: Captures a single frame from the camera preview stream.

methods.name: startBarcodeScanner
methods.comment:
Starts barcode scanning on the active camera preview.

The scanner reuses the current camera session and emits `barcodeScanned` events.
Call `stopBarcodeScanner()` when scanning is no longer needed.

Android uses the lightweight Google Play Services ML Kit model. If the model is not installed yet,
first scans may return no result until Google Play Services finishes downloading it.

methods.name: stopBarcodeScanner
methods.comment: Stops barcode scanning while keeping the camera preview running.

methods.name: getSupportedFlashModes
methods.comment: Gets the flash modes supported by the active camera.

methods.name: setAspectRatio
methods.comment: Set the aspect ratio of the camera preview.

methods.name: getAspectRatio
methods.comment: Gets the current aspect ratio of the camera preview.

methods.name: setGridMode
methods.comment: Sets the grid mode of the camera preview overlay.

methods.name: getGridMode
methods.comment: Gets the current grid mode of the camera preview overlay.

methods.name: checkPermissions
methods.comment: Checks the current camera (and optionally microphone) permission status without prompting the system dialog.

methods.name: requestPermissions
methods.comment:
Requests camera (and optional microphone) permissions. If permissions are already granted or denied,
the current status is returned without prompting. When `showSettingsAlert` is true and permissions are denied,
a platform specific alert guiding the user to the app settings will be presented.

methods.name: getHorizontalFov
methods.comment:
Gets the horizontal field of view (FoV) for the active camera.
Note: This can be an estimate on some devices.

methods.name: getSupportedPictureSizes
methods.comment: Gets the supported picture sizes for all cameras.

methods.name: setFlashMode
methods.comment: Sets the flash mode for the active camera.

methods.name: flip
methods.comment: Toggles between the front and rear cameras.

methods.name: setOpacity
methods.comment: Sets the opacity of the camera preview.

methods.name: stopRecordVideo
methods.comment: Stops an ongoing video recording.

methods.name: startRecordVideo
methods.comment:
Starts recording a video.

Supports `frameRate`, `videoCodec`, `videoBitrate`, `videoStabilizationMode`, `maxDuration`, `maxFileSize`, `disableAudio`, `allowHapticsAndSystemSoundsDuringRecording`, and `mirrorFrontCamera` on each call.

methods.name: setVideoQuality
methods.comment: Sets the video recording quality for the active camera session.

methods.name: getVideoQuality
methods.comment: Gets the current video recording quality.

methods.name: getSupportedVideoQualities
methods.comment: Returns the video qualities supported by the active camera.

methods.name: setVideoCodec
methods.comment: Sets the video codec used when recording.

methods.name: getVideoCodec
methods.comment: Gets the current video codec used for recording.

methods.name: getSupportedVideoCodecs
methods.comment: Returns the video codecs supported by the active camera.

methods.name: isVideoStabilizationSupported
methods.comment: Checks whether video stabilization is supported by the active camera.

methods.name: getSupportedVideoStabilizationModes
methods.comment: Returns the video stabilization modes supported by the active camera.

methods.name: getVideoStabilizationMode
methods.comment: Gets the current video stabilization mode.

methods.name: setVideoStabilizationMode
methods.comment:
Sets the video stabilization mode for recording.
Cannot be changed while a recording is in progress.
You can also pass `videoStabilizationMode` in `startRecordVideo()` options.

methods.name: isRunning
methods.comment: Checks if the camera preview is currently running.

methods.name: getAvailableDevices
methods.comment: Gets all available camera devices.

methods.name: getZoom
methods.comment: Gets the current zoom state, including min/max and current lens info.

methods.name: getZoomButtonValues
methods.comment:
Returns zoom button values for quick switching.
- iOS/Android: includes 0.5 if ultra-wide available; 1 and 2 if wide available; 3 if telephoto available
- Web: unsupported

methods.name: setZoom
methods.comment: Sets the zoom level of the camera.

methods.name: getFlashMode
methods.comment: Gets the current flash mode.

methods.name: removeAllListeners
methods.comment: Removes all registered listeners.

methods.name: setDeviceId
methods.comment: Switches the active camera to the one with the specified `deviceId`.

methods.name: getDeviceId
methods.comment:
Gets the ID of the camera device that is currently bound.
On Android, if a physical-lens request falls back to a logical camera, this returns the bound logical camera ID.

methods.name: getPreviewSize
methods.comment:
Gets the current visible camera preview bounds in web-view coordinates.

With `aspectMode: 'contain'`, this is the letterboxed camera image rect inside the
preview container (not the full container when bars are shown). With `aspectMode: 'cover'`,
this matches the preview container bounds on both platforms.

methods.name: setPreviewSize
methods.comment: Sets the preview size and position.

methods.name: setFocus
methods.comment:
Sets the camera focus to a specific point in the preview.

Note: The plugin does not attach any native tap-to-focus gesture handlers. Handle taps in
your HTML/JS (e.g., on the overlaying UI), then pass normalized coordinates here.

methods.name: deleteFile
methods.comment:
Deletes a file at the given absolute path on the device.
Use this to quickly clean up temporary images created with `storeToFile`.
On web, this is not supported and will throw.

methods.name: getSafeAreaInsets
methods.comment:
Gets the safe area insets for devices.
Returns the orientation-aware notch/camera cutout inset and the current orientation.
In portrait mode: returns top inset (notch at top).
In landscape mode: returns left inset (notch moved to side).
This specifically targets the cutout area (notch, punch hole, etc.) that all modern phones have.

Android: Values returned in dp (logical pixels).
iOS: Values returned in physical pixels, excluding status bar (only pure notch/cutout size).

methods.name: getOrientation
methods.comment: Gets the current device orientation in a cross-platform format.

methods.name: getExposureModes
methods.comment:
Returns the exposure modes supported by the active camera.
Modes can include: 'locked', 'auto', 'continuous', 'custom'.

methods.name: getExposureMode
methods.comment: Returns the current exposure mode.

methods.name: setExposureMode
methods.comment: Sets the exposure mode.

methods.name: getExposureCompensationRange
methods.comment: Returns the exposure compensation (EV bias) supported range.

methods.name: getExposureCompensation
methods.comment: Returns the current exposure compensation (EV bias).

methods.name: setExposureCompensation
methods.comment: Sets the exposure compensation (EV bias). Value will be clamped to range.

methods.name: getWhiteBalanceModes
methods.comment:
Returns the white-balance modes supported by the active camera.
Modes can include: 'AUTO', 'LOCK', 'CONTINUOUS'. `CUSTOM` is not listed
until manual gains support is implemented.

methods.name: getWhiteBalanceMode
methods.comment: Returns the current white-balance mode.

methods.name: setWhiteBalanceMode
methods.comment:
Sets the white-balance mode. `CONTINUOUS` keeps auto white balance running
(recommended; avoids a warm/yellow cast), `LOCK` freezes the current gains,
`AUTO` performs a one-time adjustment. `CUSTOM` is reserved and rejected
until manual gains support is implemented.

methods.name: getSupportedVideoFrameRates
methods.comment:
Lists the video frame rates supported by the active camera for the current format.
Supported values depend on the selected camera, lens, and video quality.

methods.name: getVideoFrameRate
methods.comment:
Returns the configured video frame rate for the active camera.
On Android the actual recording frame rate can still vary in low light or under thermal pressure.

methods.name: setVideoFrameRate
methods.comment:
Sets the target video frame rate for the active camera session.
Prefer passing `frameRate` to `startRecordVideo()` when starting a recording.
Rejects unsupported values with a clear error.

methods.name: getPluginVersion
methods.comment: Get the native Capacitor plugin version
